strings.world.shinryu.desc: A provincial smiths' town on the Fire Nation coast.
strings.world.sea.desc: The night cargo run of the Dawn Crane.
strings.world.republic.desc: A metropolis of neon, monorails and spirit vines.
strings.world.air_temple.desc: Chapter 2. Someone there may still remember.
strings.world.north.desc: Far to the north. The way is closed for now.
strings.quest.radio_parts.1: Master Ken needs his box of tubes. Pick it up from Gao the docker at the pier.
strings.quest.radio_parts.2: You have the box. Bring it to Master Ken on the plaza.
strings.quest.radio_parts.reward: Ken built a pocket radio and gave it to you.
strings.quest.owl_cat.1: Granny Ou lost her cat-owl Fluffy. He was seen near the vine market.
strings.quest.owl_cat.2: Fluffy won't come to strangers. Get some dried fish from a vendor.
strings.quest.owl_cat.3: Fluffy is in your arms. Take him back to Granny Ou.
strings.quest.owl_cat.reward: Fluffy is home. Granny Ou gave you the Healer's Sign.
strings.quest.radio_voices.1: Catch 4 broadcasts between 88–108 MHz (0 of 4 found).
strings.quest.radio_voices.2: Catch 4 broadcasts between 88–108 MHz (1 of 4 found).
strings.quest.radio_voices.3: Catch 4 broadcasts between 88–108 MHz (2 of 4 found).
strings.quest.radio_voices.4: Catch 4 broadcasts between 88–108 MHz (3 of 4 found).
strings.quest.radio_voices.reward: All voices found. The empty channel named a place: «the wall behind the third column».
strings.quest.paisho.1: Play Quick Deal with Old Man Lu in the ferry hold.
strings.quest.paisho.2: Now Sailor Rui. They say he never forgives a mistake.
strings.quest.paisho.3: Last is Merchant Xiao. Rumor says she owns a White Lotus.
strings.quest.paisho.reward: All rivals beaten. Xiao gave you the Sign of Riposte.
